items.text: Founding member and first director of the San Francisco Tape Music Center, later the Center for Contemporary Music at Mills College
Joined the University of California, San Diego; director of its Center for Music Experiment 1976–1979
Left UCSD and moved to upstate New York as an independent composer, performer and consultant
Founded the Pauline Oliveros Foundation (renamed Deep Listening Institute in 2005)
Coined the term deep listening after recording in the Dan Harpole cistern, Port Townsend; formed the Deep Listening Band with Stuart Dempster and Panaiotis
Taught at Mills College, UC San Diego, Oberlin Conservatory and Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute; resident at Eyebeam
